no_args.stdout:
Usage: arw <command> [options]

Commands:
  health --json  Verify the installed offline Python package and runtime.
  route --json   Emit the installed read-only ARS workflow route.
  version --json Report the installed packaged build identity.
  files          Administer registered roots and immutable file generations.
  semantic       Query an explicitly built, optional semantic projection.
  learn          Evaluate and explicitly promote evidence-bound research lessons.
  memory         Save, recall, and hand off canonical project context.
  provenance     Operate the opt-in Semantica-compatible Lite sidecar.
  orchestration-prepare/orchestration-dispatch
                 Prepare or dispatch parent-owned Phase 4 assignments.
  orchestration-panel/orchestration-gate/orchestration-hook/orchestration-recover
                 Record Phase 4 panel, gate, hook, and recovery evidence.
  storm          Run the opt-in STORM deep-research pipeline (needs the
                 optional knowledge-storm dependency group).
  init/append/replay/status and Phase 2 runtime commands are forwarded to arw.cli.
  help           Show this help text.
